$$2\Phi(1.2) - 1 = 2(0.8849) - 1 = 0.7698$$

Explain that because Machine Beta has higher variability, more of its output falls outside the specification limits:
$$0.7698 < 0.8664 \text{ because } \sigma_B > \sigma_A$$

ai_rubric.observable: Standardise the boundary for Machine Beta: z_B = (25.6 - 25.0) / 0.5 = 1.2 and write 2*Phi(1.2) - 1.
Substitute Phi(1.2) = 0.8849 to obtain 2(0.8849) - 1 = 0.7698.
Explain that both distributions share the same mean but Beta has a larger standard deviation (0.5 > 0.4), so its distribution is more spread out and less area lies within the fixed interval +-0.6 mm.

hints: Model the number of conforming washers $Y$ in the sample using the binomial distribution $Y \sim \text{B}(n, p)$.
Here $n = 5$ and $p = 0.8664$ from part a.
The condition 'at least 4' means $P(Y \ge 4) = P(Y = 4) + P(Y = 5)$.
Calculate $\binom{5}{4}(0.8664)^4(1 - 0.8664) + (0.8664)^5$ and round to 3 significant figures.

walkthrough.text:
Define the binomial model for $n = 5$ independent washers with success probability $p = 0.8664$:
$$Y \sim \text{B}(5, 0.8664), \quad q = 1 - 0.8664 = 0.1336$$

Express $P(Y \ge 4)$ as the sum of probabilities for 4 and 5 conforming washers:
$$P(Y \ge 4) = \binom{5}{4}(0.8664)^4(0.1336)^1 + \binom{5}{5}(0.8664)^5(0.1336)^0$$

teacher_walkthrough.text:
Set up the binomial distribution for repeated independent selections:
$$Y \sim \text{B}(5, 0.8664)$$

Sum the terms to find the total probability of at least 4 conforming washers:
$$0.37640 + 0.48819 = 0.86459 \approx 0.865$$
